affectedCopies: The platform-owned Restaurant demo's existing ServiceProvider rows are linked to its existing booking items through ProviderService so the slot engine routes reservations through authored table resources.

The exact demo Restaurant table providers and HospitalityResource rows receive availability only when they have none; confirmed BusinessProfile hours win, otherwise the canonical Restaurant 11:00-22:00 template is used.

Generic ProviderService links are removed only for Restaurant booking items in a storefront that contains the exact demo-table provider corpus, and only when that provider has no active table resource.
No schema field or relationship is added. Operator-owned providers, resources, schedules, bookings, holds, and availability remain outside the migration selector.

migration.backfill: Data-only and demo-scoped. Inserts missing booking-service and availability projections for providerId values matching ^demo-restaurant-prov-res-[0-8]$ under the Restaurant leaf. Existing provider/resource availability is preserved. The bounded DELETE removes only non-table ProviderService links for booking items in that same demo-backed Restaurant storefront; it does not delete providers, items, bookings, holds, resources, or allocation history. Reapplication is idempotent.
